h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bareilly

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bareilly

items.pText: Bareilly is one of the larger cities of Rohilkhand in western Uttar Pradesh, with a cantonment, many schools and colleges, and a steady growth of residential colonies and apartments. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,200 km away. The equipment travels by road and our team or a dealer in the region installs it.

Buyers in Bareilly often ask us how long a playground will last. The honest answer is that materials matter, and so does care after installation. We use galvanised steel and roto-moulded plastic because both are weather-proof and corrosion-resistant. Even so, a playground that is checked every few weeks stays in good shape far longer than one left alone until something breaks. At handover we share the maintenance steps for every piece we install.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

richText.heading: A simple maintenance routine for a Bareilly playground

items: Every week: walk around the area, pick up stones and broken glass, and check that no bolt caps are missing.
Every month: test swing chains, spring rider springs and merry-go-round bearings for play or noise, and tighten loose fixings.
Before and after the monsoon: clear the drains around the play area, and check rubber flooring for lifted edges.

items.q: How often should playground equipment be checked?
items.a: A quick walk-around every week and a closer check of chains, springs, bearings and fixings every month. Clear the drains before and after the monsoon so water does not stand under the equipment.

items.q: Where do we get spare parts after installation?
items.a: Contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 or aftersales@funplaysystems.com. Tell them the product name and send a photo of the part that needs replacing.

items.q: Do you deliver playground equipment to Bareilly?
items.a: Yes. Everything is made at our Vasai factory and sent to Bareilly by road. Our team or a dealer installs it on a grouted or self-standing base.
